explanation: A single elastic ball bouncing on the floor with large dt=1/30 and high gravity steadily gains mechanical energy with zero controller work. Positional correction / impulse at contact adds energy each bounce faster than gravity integration removes it, so total energy creeps from 150 J past the 170 J bound by step 212. With tiny dt the drift vanishes (energy stays ~150 J), pointing to contact/integration numerical energy injection at coarse steps.
